QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Powerless
QuestInfo.0: You arrived at Momijigaoka, the new base. The red maple leaves here really are quite distinctive! Someone around here must know what's going on.
QuestInfo.1: Motonari and his sons got here before you and built Momijigaoka. He asked if you were okay, and you realized that you're feeling pretty sluggish.
QuestInfo.2: Motonari thinks the laws of physics in this world are different from Sokoku's, and that's why you can't use your full power. But he thinks he can help you.
